name: Digilent Cmod A7-35T

clock.note: 12 MHz oscillator. Slow: a 1 s counter needs 24 bits.

rgb.note: RGB LED LD0. Drive 0 to light a colour. Very bright: use PWM.

button.note: BTN0-BTN1, read 1 when pressed. Mechanical: synchronise and debounce.

uart_tx.note: FPGA transmit -> USB-UART bridge -> PC. Idle high.

uart_rx.note: PC -> USB-UART bridge -> FPGA receive. Asynchronous: synchronise.

pmod_ja.note: Pmod JA. ja[0..3] = pins 1-4, ja[4..7] = pins 7-10.

gpio.note: 48-pin DIP header. pio15/pio16 are analog-only (XADC, see xa_n/xa_p); pio24/pio25 are power.

notes: No 7-segment display, switches or VGA on the module itself. The SUTD DSL kit (board 'sutd_dsl_kit') adds them.
The 512 KB SRAM (MemAdr/MemDB) and QSPI flash pins are in master.xdc if you need them.
